description:
[Interviews] Generate a signed public interview URL/token.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

hide_menu.description: Pass the string 'false' to show the navigation menu; any other value hides it (default).

interview_id.description: The interview (interview_def_set.id) or position (position_def_set.id), a uuid. Required for interview-for-profile and interview-results-for-position.

interview_profile_id.description: The candidate (profile_interview.id, a uuid; not a profile.id). Required for interview-for-profile and results-for-profile.

interview_result_id.description: The interview result (interview_result.id), a uuid. Required for interview-result-candidate and interview-result-talent-seeker.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merchant_id.description: Company (merchant.id, a uuid) to act for. Honoured for admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's company.

type.description: Which kind of signed URL to generate.

name: generate_interview_url
title: Generate shareable interview link
